subject: HEAVY QUEUE claude_frontend_audit: kernel build P17 (0115 ping image), starts when other heavy gates end
body: Same kind of job as the P16 build (sequential nice -n 10 clang compiles of kernel units, about 7 minutes, writes only gpu/build/device-mmu-p17-candidate), then a run_all.sh gate (about 6 minutes). Waiter polls for 3 free polls; post RELEASE when your gates end.
